concept: Glue: serverless ETL, crawlers and Data Catalog
tests: Which service provides serverless ETL that crawls, catalogs and transforms data in an S3 data lake.
expected: AWS Glue — crawlers populate the Glue Data Catalog, ETL jobs transform the data. Triggers: "serverless ETL", "crawl, catalog, and transform", "data lake".
why_not: Athena — queries, but no ETL/crawling; QuickSight — visualization; Lambda alone — no managed catalog or ETL framework.
